title: Schodki — koniec wspomnienia
description: Archiwalny kadr końcowy połączonego ujęcia kwasne-miny, użyty jako jego End Frame. Dariusz po lewej obejmuje Owczara po prawej po zapewnieniu, że kiedyś na pewno wygra; wspólny uśmiech wynika z pocieszenia. Nie jest osobnym klipem na aktualnym timeline. Przejście do dorosłego Dariusza w garażu wykonujemy w montażu.

prompts.image: Use case: sketch-to-render / photorealistic-natural. Create ONE final live-action film still, 16:9, ideally 1920x1080. Input 1 is a WORKING BLENDER RENDER, strictly a camera, spatial layout, scale and composition reference, NOT the final visual style. Input 2 is a SMALL PERSPECTIVE/BLOCKING GUIDE of the same camera: its converging lines explain real spatial directions and its primitive figures mark human placement. Do not reproduce the guide, linework, captions, faceted bodies, plastic surfaces or crude geometry. Rebuild the visible scene as a convincing photographed physical place while retaining the prescribed viewpoint, major dimensions, openings, object positions and framing. Improve natural material variation, construction details, contact shadows and realistic light; do not redesign the layout or invent different architecture. No game-engine look, no illustration, no split panels, no watermark. Early-1990s provincial Polish atmosphere, understated cinematic realism and restrained film grain, no modern products. Input 3 is the exact production identity and wardrobe reference: Dariusz is the chubby red-brown wavy-haired boy with rectangular dark glasses on the LEFT of that reference; Owczar is the slim dark-blond boy in the burgundy track jacket on its RIGHT. Both are 13–14, clean-shaven. Preserve their specific faces, hair, age, body shape and clothing. Owczar has TWO cream stripes on each sleeve, ivory T-shirt, loose blue jeans and worn pale canvas trainers. Dariusz has an open grey-blue plaid overshirt, grey/navy striped T-shirt, dark loose jeans and dark worn trainers. Their positions in the final shot are dictated by the shot instructions, not by the identity reference layout. Replace all visible primitive stand-ins with anatomically natural boys, and insert the boys where requested even if the clean render is empty. No adult beard, no extra people. SHOT ACTION AND COMPOSITION: Both boys seated on the upper step beside the closed side door, leaving entrance clear. Dariusz screen left rests his arm across Owczar shoulders, Owczar screen right leans comfortably toward him. Each retains one opened paper sachet. Relaxed shared laugh, feet physically supported, no extra people. Soft urban overcast daylight, believable worn materials and subtle dirt without theatrical decay. Keep the same natural atmosphere across the street and shop sequence.  Input 4 specifies only the exact PAPER SACHET artwork and lettering; this is a palm-sized 6 by 9 cm paper packet, not a box. The printed glass is an illustration on the packet, never an actual glass in the scene. Preserve the orange and green print.
